independentReview.scope: Read-only model/UI/harness review, independent DTO/state oracle, public API delegation instrumentation and browser-bundle initialization without a DOM root. No repository edits, fullcheck, Worker, HTTP, browser or database execution by this reviewer.
independentReview.oracleMethod: Expectations prepared before implementation read, using independent Python linear scans for exact SKU/tuple ownership and related-row diagnostics, stdlib CSV decoding for the closed valid fixture, and manually located invalid fields. Complete projected DTOs compared for ten scenarios and eleven reachable states; 110 patches with 11 no-ops and 99 changes. This does not repeat domain a/b/c maximum-size matrices.

delegation.scope: Isolated instrumentation of actual public model imports. Invalid CSV never reaches SKU lookup; valid passes the same complete list object; history evaluates only historical API. Five perturbations confirm projection/closed labels. Private raw snapshot getters never read.

gateOnlyDiagnostic.scope: Single gate export, not a served asset; historical inert tables may remain from public barrel.

staticReview.model: Full source read: actual public evaluator calls, strict canonical state, safe projection, closed diagnostic labels, no inferred historical identities or partial CSV flow, no implicit clock/effects. Model and test hashes match the author freeze.
staticReview.tests: All final 25 tests read: independent semantic examples, whole-list identity delegation, separate historical path, mutant projections, hostile descriptors/prototypes, detached normalization and gate AND. Author tests not rerun by reviewer.
staticReview.ui: Component/page fully read by independent child company_ui_review and main reviewer integration checked; SSR disabled controls/noscript, persistent selector/reset, textContent raw SKU/CSV, null cleanup, no numeric IDs/refs or operation forms, AND gate in page and admin navigation. Static review is not an accessibility execution.
staticReview.harness: Browser harness and twenty a11y surfaces read: raw text equality, placeholders/hidden flags, 14 result rows, six historical rows, two zero rows, invalid CSV no partial identity lookup, cross-family cleanup, keyboard/reset/reload/no-JS; guide storage and exact known shell rAF separated. No browser run by reviewer.
